data.title: Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing Boosts Asset-Backed Finance in Livestock Sector
data.description:
Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing Co. Ltd. Class H ( (HK:1601) ) has issued an announcement.

Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing Co., Ltd. has expanded its leasing portfolio with three finance lease deals involving PRC companies engaged in breeding feed, pig farming, pork processing and modern slaughtering. Acting as lessor, it acquires these firms’ production assets and leases them back, reinforcing its role as a financier to the agricultural and food-processing supply chain.

The latest Finance Lease Agreement III, signed on October 16, 2026, covers RMB23 million of assets and will generate total payments of about RMB24.63 million over 24 months, while two earlier agreements from November 2025 added a further RMB19.6 million in principal. As the series of transactions exceeds the 5% threshold under Hong Kong Listing Rules, they are classified as a discloseable transaction, underscoring the growing scale of the company’s leasing operations and the financial implications for shareholders who track its interest income and regulatory compliance.

data.title: Baige Online Wins Shareholder Backing for Share Circulation Plan and Board Changes
data.description:
Baige Online Digital Technology Co. Ltd. Class H ( (HK:2672) ) has shared an update.

Baige Online Digital Technology Co., Ltd. has secured shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting held on 16 October 2026 for all five ordinary resolutions put to a poll. Key items endorsed include the application for full circulation of the company’s unlisted shares and authorisation for the board to manage related procedures, alongside additional remuneration for two executive directors.

The meeting also formalised a board reshuffle, with shareholders approving the appointment of Zhu Tao as a non-executive director and Lu Weidong as an independent non-executive director, replacing outgoing directors Zheng Yu and Jiang Min. These changes strengthen the company’s governance structure and support its move toward greater share liquidity, which may broaden its investor base and enhance alignment between management and shareholders.
